lines.text: The writer hopes in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy soon, and says he has nobody else like him.
Timothy served like a child with his father, and the writer hopes to send him after seeing what happens.
The writer thought it necessary to send back Epaphroditus, his brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and the Philippians' messenger.
Epaphroditus was sick nearly unto death, and God had mercy on him and on Timothy, sparing sorrow upon sorrow.
